contracts_rationale: Configuration-surface change only: no API, wire or schema contract is added or changed. The HTTP side effect of bean validation (400 for a body missing a required field) is admitted by the existing default Problem response (research.md R2).
purpose_context: ADR-0041 gives the containerised charter service a container profile that is never the default. Its settings are bound into a separate validated record at charter.container.*, so a misconfigured container fails at start with the property named instead of serving nothing or serving to anyone. The local loopback daemon is unchanged. Issue #228 under epic #226.
purpose_tldr: A validated charter.container.* properties record that fails the start of a container-profile service when a value is missing or invalid (#228).
